app.title: AI3 Cross-Domain Transfer
app.footer: Pure frontend · keys stay in your wallet · XDM protocol fee ~0.01% · min transfer 1 AI3

stillBridging.title: Still bridging
stillBridging.message: The 30-minute arrival window has elapsed without a detected balance change. XDM transfers can take longer — use Refresh Balance or the history panel to check again.

inclusionTimeout.title: Transaction not yet seen on chain
inclusionTimeout.message: The transaction may still be waiting in the mempool. Do NOT resubmit it with the same account (Subspace rejects duplicate nonces) — check the history panel later.

retracted.title: Transaction Retracted
retracted.message: The transaction was retracted by the network. Please check your wallet and try again.

finalityTimeout.title: Transaction Timeout
finalityTimeout.message: Finality timed out. It may still finalize, so please check your transaction history. If not, please retry.

transferFailed.title: Transfer Failed
transferFailed.message: The transaction was {0}. Please ensure you have sufficient balance and network connectivity, then try again.

invalidAmount.title: Invalid Amount
invalidAmount.message: The minimum transfer amount is {0} AI3. Please enter a valid amount to proceed.

walletsNotConnected.title: Wallets Not Connected
walletsNotConnected.message: Please connect both your Consensus and EVM wallets to proceed with the transfer.

transferInitFailed.title: Transfer Initiation Failed
transferInitFailed.hint: Please ensure both wallets are connected, you have sufficient balance, and try again.

notifications.e2cProviderMissing: No usable EVM source. Connect MetaMask, or connect a SubWallet/Talisman consensus account that has an EVM account.

noConsensusAccounts.title: No Consensus accounts found
noConsensusAccounts.message: Install and unlock a Substrate wallet extension (SubWallet or Talisman), then refresh and try again.

consensusConnectFailed.title: Consensus wallet connection failed
consensusConnectFailed.message: Connection failed: {0}. Make sure the extension is installed, unlocked, and has accounts, then try again.

evmLinkSkipped.title: EVM linking skipped
evmLinkSkipped.message: The connected wallet ('{0}') does not expose a linked EVM address. EVM → Consensus transfers are disabled; Consensus → EVM works.

evmWalletNotFound.title: EVM wallet not found
evmWalletNotFound.message: Install an EVM-compatible wallet (e.g. MetaMask) to connect.

evmConnectFailed.title: EVM wallet connection failed
evmConnectFailed.message: Could not connect to the wallet: {0}

txCancelled.title: Transaction cancelled
txCancelled.message: You declined the signature request in your wallet. Nothing was sent.

wallet.evmNotDetected: No EVM wallet extension detected (MetaMask etc.)

docs.title: Documentation
docs.c2eBody: Handled automatically via the app. Funds usually arrive within 10–30 minutes (measured ~25 min on mainnet).
docs.e2cBody: Sent via the transporter precompile on Auto-EVM. Funds are expected to arrive on the Consensus chain after the ~24-hour challenge period. Please proceed with caution. For manual transfers, you can still use this guide: {0}.
docs.setupConsensus: Consensus: Use SubWallet/Talisman with Autonomys Consensus (RPC: {0}, SS58 {1}).
docs.setupEvm: EVM: Add Auto-EVM to MetaMask (ID {0} via {1}).
docs.setupSdkLink: This app is built using the {0} and {1}.

transfer.title: Consensus → Auto-EVM
transfer.needConsensusWallet: Connect the Consensus wallet to transfer
transfer.arrivalNoteC2E: Arrival ≈ amount × 99.99% (XDM protocol fee ~0.01%). Usually 10–30 minutes, occasionally longer.
transfer.arrivalNoteE2C: Funds arrive on Consensus after the ~24-hour challenge period.
transfer.amountPrecision: At most 18 decimal places are supported. Please adjust the amount.

e2cConfirmed.title: Transfer Confirmed on Auto-EVM
e2cConfirmed.message: Your transfer of {0} AI3 to {1} has been confirmed on Auto-EVM. Funds arrive on the Consensus chain after the ~24-hour challenge period. Keep this entry in the history panel and mark it as received once the funds land.

e2cInBlock.title: Transfer Submitted
e2cInBlock.message: Your transfer has been successfully submitted and included in a block. It is expected to arrive on the Consensus chain after approximately 14,400 blocks (around 24 hours). You can now safely close this window or start another transfer.

transfer.needEvmSource: This transfer needs an EVM source: connect MetaMask, or a SubWallet/Talisman consensus account with an EVM account

progress.title: Progress
progress.empty: No transfers in flight. Transfers you start will show up here in real time.
